arguments.title: 사과 바나나 냠냠냠 | 모모타임 율동형 시안
arguments.style: Original Korean preschool action-dance nursery rhyme for ages 2-4. Immediate catchy sung hook; 126 BPM, very clear straight 2/4 bounce, punchy gentle kick and crisp handclaps, bright toy-keyboard stabs and small playful synth-brass answers. A light, clear, high, smiling girl-like female solo, naturally cute without pitch-shift effects; tiny unison responses on 냠냠냠. A simple three-note melody, short syllabic phrases, exact repeated hook, strong beat accents and tiny breath spaces for a toddler to copy. Fruit names always clearly articulated in native Korean. Playful stop-and-go vocal accents while the beat continues. Start singing in the first second. Each short lyric line about one bar. Finish the final 냠 phrase with a resolved chord. Compact 40-50 second hook audition.
arguments.lyrics:
[Hook - immediate singing, each short line about one bar]
사과 사과
냠냠냠
바나나 바나나
냠냠냠
사과 냠
바나나 냠
냠냠 냠냠
냠냠냠

[Action - same small melody, beat keeps going]
사과 보고
짝짝짝
바나나 보고
짝짝짝

[Hook - identical melody and rhythm]
사과 사과
냠냠냠
바나나 바나나
냠냠냠
사과 냠
바나나 냠
냠냠 냠냠
냠냠냠

[Ending - sung, resolved]
사과 바나나
냠냠냠!
[End]
